introHeadline: A composed South Flagler address with Palm Beach-adjacent scale.
introDek: South Flagler House is the formal South Flagler entry in West Palm Beach's condo pipeline: RAMSA architecture, a lake-facing setting, and a private-club amenity program built around long-term residence.
brookeTake: South Flagler House is for buyers who want Palm Beach architectural cues translated into a staffed condominium. The draw is the combination of Robert A.M. Stern architecture, Related Ross execution, Pembrooke & Ives interiors, and a quieter South Flagler posture.
bestFor: Buyers who want a grand but composed waterfront address
Palm Beach-oriented buyers who want condo service without losing traditional architectural character
Clients comparing South Flagler calm against North Flagler resort energy
Buyers who care about architectural pedigree and long-term resale audience
signatureFeatures: Designed by Robert A.M. Stern Architects
Developed by Related Ross
Interiors by Pembrooke & Ives
108 residences including larger homes, penthouses, and guest-suite options
Approximately 50,000 square feet of private club amenities
Lakefront pool, cabanas, spa, hydrotherapy, salon, fitness, dining, and sports simulator lounge
amenityNarrative: The amenity program is best understood as a private club layered into a residential building. Rather than relying on one headline feature, South Flagler House stacks wellness, dining, pool, salon, fitness, and social spaces into a complete daily-life setting.
residenceNarrative: The residences are positioned for buyers who want scale, traditional luxury cues, and a more permanent sense of home. Larger layouts, penthouse offerings, and guest-suite options make the project relevant for buyers replacing a Palm Beach house or adding a West Palm Beach residence with similar formality.
locationNarrative: South Flagler is its own lane. It is close to Palm Beach, Worth Avenue, Royal Poinciana Plaza, and the Norton Museum, but it feels more residential than the increasingly active North Flagler and Downtown corridors.
buyerComparisonNotes: Compare South Flagler House against Shorecrest and Edgeworth for the Related Ross waterfront pipeline, against Olara for resort/marina lifestyle, and against Ritz-Carlton Residences for branded-service North Flagler living. South Flagler House is the more formal, estate-inspired option in that set.
projectTeamNarrative: The team is central to the pitch: Related Ross as developer, Robert A.M. Stern Architects for the architecture, Pembrooke & Ives for interiors, and SMI Landscape Architecture for the outdoor setting. Together, the project leans into permanence and Palm Beach-adjacent formality rather than a glass-tower identity.
sourceNotes: Developer source positions the project as a legacy-style waterfront address inspired by Palm Beach's grand estates.

introHeadline: North Flagler living with marina, wellness, and culinary energy.
introDek: Olara is the active North Flagler choice: expansive amenities, private marina context, wellness programming, and a Jose Andres culinary partnership along the Intracoastal.
brookeTake: Olara is for the buyer who wants the building to feel alive. This is not the quiet-estate version of West Palm Beach; it is more social, food-and-wellness driven, and tied to the future of North Flagler as a lifestyle corridor.
bestFor: Buyers who want active waterfront living
Boaters or water-oriented buyers drawn to private marina access
Clients who value wellness, dining, service, and amenity volume
Buyers comparing North Flagler momentum against South Flagler composure
signatureFeatures: North Flagler Drive waterfront location along the Intracoastal
Private marina
More than 80,000 square feet of wellness and leisure amenities
Signature dining associated with Chef Jose Andres
Architecture by Arquitectonica
Interiors by Gabellini Sheppard
Lap and leisure pool, spa, fitness, and resort-style service language
amenityNarrative: Olara's amenity story is broad and lifestyle-driven. The marina, spa, pools, dining, and wellness spaces make the building feel like an active residential club where much of the daily routine is close at hand.
residenceNarrative: The residences are positioned around generous scale, waterfront connection, and refined materials. The project is especially relevant for buyers who want new construction with a strong social and wellness identity.
locationNarrative: North Flagler is becoming one of West Palm Beach's most important development corridors. Olara benefits from that momentum while offering more privacy than Downtown and a more animated daily rhythm than South Flagler.
buyerComparisonNotes: Compare Olara against Ritz-Carlton Residences for staffed residential operations, Alba for boutique scale, and South Flagler House for a more formal South Flagler product. Olara's edge is its marina lifestyle and amenity scale.
projectTeamNarrative: The project team reinforces the resort/residential positioning: Arquitectonica brings recognizable South Florida architectural experience, Gabellini Sheppard shapes the interior language, and the Jose Andres dining connection gives the building a stronger culinary identity than most condo projects.
sourceNotes: Developer source describes a luxury waterfront residential oasis with resort-level service, private marina, and major wellness/leisure amenity program.
Official site previously listed residences from approximately $1.7M and indicated construction rising at full scale; verify current status before publication.

introHeadline: The boutique North Flagler waterfront alternative.
introDek: Alba Palm Beach is a smaller-scale condominium for buyers who want new construction on the Intracoastal without the mega-tower feel. With only 55 residences, townhome options, and a more residential North Flagler setting, Alba sits in a quieter lane than many larger projects nearby.
brookeTake: Alba is compelling because it is not trying to be everything to everyone. It is boutique, direct-waterfront, and more neighborhood-scaled. For the right buyer, that smaller footprint may matter more than having the longest amenity list in town.
bestFor: Buyers who prefer boutique buildings over large towers
Clients who want direct Intracoastal positioning with a quieter residential feel
Buyers looking for a more intimate North Flagler option
Clients considering townhome-style living within a luxury waterfront project
signatureFeatures: Only 55 total residences
Direct Intracoastal waterfront setting
More than 25,000 square feet of dedicated amenity spaces
Two- and three-bedroom residences plus four-bedroom townhomes
Located at 4714 North Flagler Drive
Boutique scale compared with larger West Palm Beach luxury towers
amenityNarrative: Alba offers a meaningful amenity package, but its strongest differentiator is proportion. The building does not need to compete with the largest amenity programs to make sense; its appeal is a more personal environment with enough lifestyle support to feel complete.
residenceNarrative: The residence mix gives Alba a different buyer profile than many towers. The inclusion of larger townhome-style options broadens the appeal for buyers who want new construction and waterfront access but still like the feel of a more grounded home environment.
locationNarrative: Alba's North Flagler location is quieter and more residential than Downtown, while still participating in the same broader corridor transformation. It is best understood as a boutique option rather than an amenity mega-project.
buyerComparisonNotes: Compare Alba against Olara for North Flagler activity at a larger scale, Ritz-Carlton Residences for branded service, and South Flagler House for formal estate-inspired luxury. Alba's advantage is intimacy, direct waterfront setting, and boutique building size.
projectTeamNarrative: The project should be presented through its scale, waterfront siting, and residence mix first. Verified sources support BGI Companies / Kenneth Baboun, Blue Road, Spina O'Rourke + Partners, Schmidt Nichols, Moss Construction, and One Sotheby's International Realty; do not add unsourced team roles.
sourceNotes: Developer source positions Alba as limited-edition boutique waterfront living with 55 residences and dedicated amenity spaces.
Official site referenced final release timing, closings expected to commence in June 2026, and a limited HOA incentive through May 31, 2026. Verify all timing and incentives before publishing.

introHeadline: Private waterfront residences with a recognized service platform.
introDek: The Ritz-Carlton Residences West Palm Beach is a 27-story condominium planned with 138 homes, water-facing views, and residential operations associated with the Ritz-Carlton name. For buyers, the useful read is how the floor plan, exposure, staffing model, and monthly cost structure fit daily life.
brookeTake: This building is for a buyer who wants a managed, polished environment without making the residence feel like a hotel stay. The right comparison is line by line: view, balcony, elevator access, service expectations, fees, and how the address will feel as Flagler Drive keeps changing.
bestFor: Buyers who want private ownership with staffed residential operations
Clients who value brand recognition but still need a practical floor-plan review
Buyers comparing service-led living against marina, boutique, or estate-style alternatives
Clients who want concierge, valet, wellness, and a calmer water-facing residence
signatureFeatures: Official project sources support 138 residences across 27 stories
Related Group and BH Group development team
Architecture by Arquitectonica
Interiors by Rockwell Group
Landscape architecture by Naturalficial
Water-facing homes with private balconies, wellness amenities, concierge, and valet service reported in current materials
amenityNarrative: The amenity question is operational. Buyers should understand how concierge, valet, wellness, pool, lounge, and staffing work in practice, then compare that daily support against buildings that lead with marina access, larger club programs, or boutique privacy.
residenceNarrative: The residences should be evaluated by light, balcony depth, view corridor, elevator access, storage, parking, and how each line lives at different floors. The best unit is the one where the plan and exposure justify the premium, not simply the one attached to the strongest brand name.
locationNarrative: The site sits in the active Flagler Drive waterfront corridor, close to Palm Beach access and downtown West Palm Beach. The buyer test is practical: views, bridge pattern, construction context, and how the surrounding pipeline may affect the address by completion.
buyerComparisonNotes: Compare Ritz-Carlton Residences against Olara for marina energy, Alba for boutique scale, Mandarin Oriental for another hospitality-branded North Flagler option, and South Flagler House for a more formal product.
projectTeamNarrative: The team is part of the underwriting story. Related Group and BH Group supply the development platform, Arquitectonica shapes the tower, Rockwell Group defines the interior atmosphere, Naturalficial handles the landscape layer, and the Ritz-Carlton affiliation sets operational expectations. Each role should be confirmed against the current buyer packet before contract reliance.
sourceNotes: Official project/developer sources support 138 residences, 27 stories, Related Group, BH Group, Arquitectonica, Rockwell Group, Naturalficial, and Ritz-Carlton residential branding.
Address references vary across official contexts; use 1717 N Flagler as the current developer/legal address until offering documents confirm final street-address language.
